meta.title: Experiences — Villa Mandara
meta.description: Private experiences and bespoke care at Villa Mandara — pre-arrival shopping, gym access, massage and kinesitherapy, a private chef or butler.

shopping.title: Pre-arrival shopping
shopping.description: Tell us what you love and we'll make sure the fridge and the bar are stocked before you even step through the door. Request the products you'd like ahead of time or at any point during your stay, and we'll take care of them — so you have nothing to think about but your holiday.

gym.title: Gym access
gym.description: As a guest of Mandara you enjoy entirely free access to the Naydenov fitness centre in Montana. Across 1,000 m² you'll find space, modern equipment and everything you need for a complete workout — whether you keep to your routine or simply want to move between the quiet days.

massage.title: Massage & kinesitherapy
massage.description: Let the body truly rest. Visit our kinesitherapist at the Naydenov fitness centre in Montana, or request a massage in the villa, so we can complete the calm of Mandara with care you can genuinely feel.

chef.title: Chef / butler
chef.description: To make your stay entirely carefree, on prior request we arrange a private chef or a butler. Get in touch after booking and we'll prepare everything — you simply enjoy the taste, the attention and the free time.
